rationale: The only implementation delta is that the fixed version initializes msg->msg_namelen to 0 before performing any connection-state or flag checks. The Logic section does not mention msg_namelen or any initialization of message-header metadata. All described steps—connection and flag validation, virtual-circuit status checks, datagram reception, truncation handling, conditional memory return for non-peek operations, datagram freeing, and returning the copied byte count—are present in both implementations.
